finalIdentityPolicy: Use the exact successful workflow GITHUB_SHA and GITHUB_RUN_ID; never hard-code a historical CI identity as final evidence.

reviewItems.issue: Real WWHN-78/HN-UAT-003 defect register is not published in the current Jira chain.
reviewItems.feDisposition: FE defines the immutable schema and refuses to fabricate UAT rows. Each real defect must bind before evidence, exact fix SHA/files and after evidence.

reviewItems.issue: Historical assessment used stale exact HEAD and CI #488.
reviewItems.feDisposition: Dedicated WWHN-292 workflow runs format, lint, typecheck, tests, task verifier, build and task-specific Playwright against the exact runtime GITHUB_SHA.

reviewItems.issue: WWHN-293 has no independent QA2 retest.
reviewItems.feDisposition: FE publishes task-specific controlled handoff evidence only. QA2 must independently retest the exact deployed FE/BE identity.

reviewItems.issue: Controlled FE evidence is not named DEV/UAT runtime evidence.
reviewItems.feDisposition: No DEV/UAT PASS is claimed. Real environment evidence must include account/role, browser, viewport, FE SHA, BE SHA, request ID and direct authorization result where applicable.

reviewItems.issue: Canonical WWHN-292 task artifact was absent from current m1.
reviewItems.feDisposition: A task-specific document, structured closure register, verifier, E2E suite and workflow now exist. WWHN-156 is dependency context only and is no longer a substitute artifact.

reviewItems.issue: Stale/invalid branch or SHA links can break immutable traceability.
reviewItems.feDisposition: Canonical branch is m1. The workflow writes EXACT_GIT_SHA, GITHUB_RUN_ID, GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT and SHA256SUMS only after prior gates pass.

reviewItems.issue: Generic evidence suite used tablet 1024x768 instead of the required 768x1024.
reviewItems.feDisposition: Dedicated WWHN-292 E2E uses exactly 1440x900, 768x1024 and 375x812 and writes task-specific metadata/evidence.

reviewItems.issue: Responsive evidence was described as shell/login but only /login was exercised; the authenticated shell (aside, header, content) was unproven at the required viewports.
reviewItems.feDisposition: Added authenticated-shell responsive tests at 1440x900, 1280x900 (NFR-SRS-006 desktop minimum), 768x1024 and 375x812. Each asserts no horizontal overflow and the wireframe shell contract: fixed 300px aside with 300px main offset above 980px, static full-width aside with zero offset at or below 980px.

reviewItems.issue: Route-level fail-closed was proven on a single sample route, so a regression on any other protected route would not be caught.
reviewItems.feDisposition: Added a 13-route direct-URL matrix for a limited role holding only inventory.view; each route must redirect to /errors/403, render the explicit no-permission state and keep its menu entry hidden. A positive control asserts /inventory stays reachable so the guard is not over-blocking.

overallStatus.truthRule: Do not claim 100 percent UAT/project acceptance until real defect disposition, independent QA2 retest and backend runtime authorization evidence are attached to the exact deployed build identity.

responsiveContract.scope: login screen AND authenticated application shell
